topic: Replay of session logs runs in orchd (new ReplaySpaces RPC)
detail: The session form of 'orch spaces replay' asks orchd (ReplaySpaces, operator-only) rather than reading orch.db and the command log from the CLI: stored revisions name every job's orgs and roots (DiffSpaces is operator-only for that reason) and the log is readable only by the operator or its own session (INV-12), so reading them client-side would bypass those gates. The payload-file form stays in the CLI with no orchd, so CI can replay the SP-001 fixtures. An argument holding '/' or '.' is a path (log owners cannot hold either). Payload fixtures carry no recorded verdicts, so CI compares their replayed verdicts with a committed golden file.
